## Priority Dental Treatments
- [All Dental Treatments & Services Hub](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-services): Overview of 9 dental specialties offered at the clinic.
- [Dentist in Chipiyana Buzurg, Ghaziabad](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dentist-chipiyana-buzurg-ghaziabad): Local clinic directions, timings, and general dental services.
- [Dental Implants in Ghaziabad](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-implants): Single tooth, multi-tooth, and implant-supported prosthetics.
- [Full Mouth Dental Implants](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/full-mouth-dental-implants): Full-arch All-on-4 and All-on-6 implant rehabilitation.
- [Dental Implant After Tooth Extraction](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-implant-after-tooth-extraction): Immediate vs delayed implant placement evaluation.
- [Root Canal Treatment (RCT)](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/root-canal-treatment): Rotary endodontic treatment and Re-RCT under local anesthesia.
- [Wisdom Tooth Extraction](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/wisdom-tooth-extraction): Simple and surgical third-molar removal.
- [Impacted Wisdom Tooth Treatment](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/impacted-wisdom-tooth): Diagnosis and surgical care for impacted wisdom teeth.
- [Smile Makeover in Ghaziabad](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/smile-makeover-ghaziabad): Customized aesthetic smile design combining veneers, crowns, whitening, and aligners.
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/cosmetic-dentistry): Composite bonding, veneers, gap closure, and aesthetic restorations.
- [Dental Veneers](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-veneers): Porcelain and composite veneers for chipped, stained, or spaced front teeth.
- [Zirconia Crowns](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/zirconia-crowns): Metal-free zirconia caps for root canal-treated and fractured teeth.
- [Tooth Cap & Dental Crowns](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/tooth-cap): PFM, E-Max ceramic, and zirconia dental crowns.
- [Fixed Dental Bridges](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-bridges): Ceramic and zirconia bridges for missing teeth.
- [Complete & Partial Dentures](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dentures): Custom acrylic, flexible, cast partial, and implant-supported dentures.
- [Teeth Cleaning & Scaling](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/teeth-cleaning): Ultrasonic scaling and polishing for plaque and tartar removal.
- [Teeth Whitening](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/teeth-whitening): Clinically supervised in-office teeth whitening.
- [Gum Disease & Periodontal Treatment](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/periodontal-gum-treatment-ghaziabad): Bleeding gums, gum recession, and periodontitis care.
- [Dental Braces](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-braces) & [Clear Aligners](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/clear-aligners): Orthodontic alignment for teens and adults.
- [Dental Fillings](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/dental-fillings) & [Cavity Treatment](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/cavity-treatment): Tooth-colored composite and GIC restorations.
- [Emergency Dentist in Ghaziabad](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/emergency-dentist-ghaziabad): Same-day urgent evaluation for severe toothache, swelling, abscesses, and broken teeth.
- [Kids Dentist](https://oracledentals.netlify.app/kids-dentist): Gentle pediatric dental checkups, fluoride, and sealants.
